title: YouTube Educational Video Content Creator
description: I want to turn solid educational ideas into YouTube videos that are clear, visually engaging, and consistently on-brand. The plan is to publish only on YouTube, so everything we do—from scripting through thumbnail design—should align with the platform’s best practices and SEO guidelines. Here’s the flow I imagine: we brainstorm topics together, you convert them into concise scripts with a strong narrative arc, then handle the full post-production cycle—editing, transitions, captioning, basic motion graphics, royalty-free music, and a scroll-stopping thumbnail. Clear messaging is the priority; every scene should serve the lesson, never distract from it. I already have a rough content calendar and audience insights. Your creative thinking, trend research, and sharp communication skills will help refine that calendar and keep uploads consistent. Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve is welcome—as is any proven method you use to keep videos punchy yet informative. Deliverables for each video: • Final 1080p (or higher) YouTube-ready file • Editable project files and asset list • SRT or built-in captions • Custom thumbnail (1280 × 720) matching channel style Acceptance criteria: • Message remains crystal clear throughout • Visuals reinforce, never clutter, the teaching point • All assets cleared for copyright and commercial use • Files delivered on or before the agreed date If this sounds like a fit, share a link to two or three YouTube videos you’ve produced that demonstrate crisp storytelling and clean educational pacing. Looking forward to collaborating on content that both informs and delights.
